posts.texte: GTA 6 is officially out in Japan and South Korea!

New GTA 6 bonuses included for GTA+ members, in addition to free items.

GTA+ benefits:
- ‘90 Annis Venturas BLVD Elegy widebody sports car
- A garage in the Crosstown district with a weapon locker and the ability to directly fence stolen items
- Scooter Bros Premium vehicle care
Jason getting eaten by an alligator in GTA 6.

GTA 6 runs at a 1440p base resolution on both PS5 and PS5 Pro, with PSSR upscaling the Pro version to 4K

The frame rate stays at an “unwavering” 30 FPS on PS5 Pro, while base PS5 can drop into the mid-20s depending on the scenery
